dataset.description:
This database has been designed to collect information on different examples of market based mechanisms promoting fire mitigation among land managers in Europe.
The aim is to provide a list of case studies in Europe that bring different examples of economic incentives to reduce the risk of wildfires.
This database is part of Task 3.1 in WP3 of the FIRE-RES project and will be used to prepare a policy brief (D3.1)
dataset.preservation_statement: The dataset is going to be preserved over time.
dataset.title: ACRONYM. WP1. Short title. V2

dmp.description:
The FIRE-RES project is a 4-year project (2021-2025) funder under the H2020 innovation programme whose scope is to effectively promote the implementation of a holistic fire management approach and support the transition towards more resilient landscapes and communities to Extreme Wildfire Events (EWE) in Europe. FIRE-RES brings together a transdisciplinary, multi-actor consortium of 34 partners, formed be researchers, emerging-responsible bodies, technological companies, industrial and civil society from 12 countries, linking to broader networks in science and disaster reduction management.
The project is structured into a set of (a) work packages (WP) to develop and implement the project’s approach as well as its Innovation Actions’ (IA) (b) components over relevant geographic, temporal and decision-making scales in the project’s Living Labs. IAs will be demonstrated and deployed (c), and finally upscaled and communicated/disseminated (d). This will be influential to design resilient and resistant landscapes.
In H2020, it is expected that beneficiaries make the research data generated by the Project findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable (FAIR). This requires sound research data management. The aim of the Data Management Plan (DMP) (D9.2) is to guarantee the deployment of best practices in Data Management to ensure the security and availability of data, for internal and external consortium cooperation.
The DMP describe the management of the data generated within the project, from its collection to treatment, storage and sharing processes, always according to the FAIR principles while considering the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
The DMP is designed to be a living document during the project, reviewed and updated every 6 months by INESC TEC (acting as DMP manager) in collaboration with WPL and other partners and shall be aligned with the recommendations of the Ethics and Diversity panel (EDP).

project.description: FIRE-RES will develop a holistic and integrated fire management strategy to efficiently and effectively address Extreme Wildfire Events in Europe in 11 Living Labs thanks to its Innovation Actions.
